bead.title: claude-tui/gate: capture /usage deltas for `claude --print` mode run 1
bead.description:
PROBLEM: ADR-013's economic premise hinges on `claude --print` consuming API-metered request paths rather than the subscription window. The first empirical `--print` run is not captured, so the API-metering claim remains unverified.

ROOT CAUSE: docs/helix/02-design/billing-observation-claude-tui.md:1 has an empty `--print mode measurements` placeholder and no Run 1 `/usage` snapshots or turn output for this mode.

PROPOSED FIX: Dependency ID: fizeau-a45dafe6. Governing artifact: ADR-013. Using the model, prompt, account, and refresh-delay defined in docs/helix/02-design/billing-observation-claude-tui.md, run `claude --print` once against the same authenticated account and append a labeled `Run 1` entry to the `--print mode measurements` section. Capture the `/usage` snapshot BEFORE, the full turn output, completion timestamp, and the `/usage` snapshot AFTER at refresh-delay + safety margin, >=60s post-completion. Record wall-clock timestamps for both snapshots and attest no concurrent claude activity from the same account during Run 1.

NON-SCOPE: PTY+hooks measurements, delta computation, verdict determination, ADR-013 disposition, methodology authoring, Runs 2-3 capture except for preserving their existing content.

AC:
1) TestPrintModeRun1Labeled: doc's `--print mode measurements` section contains one labeled Run 1 entry.
2) TestPrintModeRun1BeforeAfterSnapshots: Run 1 has BEFORE and AFTER `/usage` snapshot blocks.
3) TestPrintModeRun1TurnOutputRecorded: Run 1 includes the full captured `claude --print` turn output.
4) TestPrintModeRun1SnapshotTimestamps: Run 1 BEFORE and AFTER snapshots each have wall-clock timestamps.
5) TestPrintModeRun1AfterRespectsRefreshDelay: Run 1 AFTER snapshot timestamp is >= completion-time + documented refresh-delay safety margin and >=60s post-completion.
6) TestPrintModeRun1SingleAccountAttested: Run 1 attests no concurrent claude activity from the same account during its measurement window.

GATES: `go test ./...` passes; `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
bead.acceptance:
1) TestPrintModeRun1Labeled
2) TestPrintModeRun1BeforeAfterSnapshots
3) TestPrintModeRun1TurnOutputRecorded
4) TestPrintModeRun1SnapshotTimestamps
5) TestPrintModeRun1AfterRespectsRefreshDelay
6) TestPrintModeRun1SingleAccountAttested
Gates: `go test ./...`, `lefthook run pre-commit`.
